items.title: Laurena Diggs and Carrie Boote Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know a fella called Nora Dutry? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I thought he was from here.

ctx.x: Yeah, I thought he was from here.
You know a fella called Nora Dutry? The trombone player, Honoré Dutry, Nora. He was up there, you know. It was all King Oliver fellas,
